stores.help.apple.title: How do I get an App Store Connect key?
stores.help.apple.1: Sign in to App Store Connect with an account that has the Admin role – only Admins can create team keys.
stores.help.apple.2: Open Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API → Team Keys.
stores.help.apple.3: Click "Generate API Key" (or +), enter a name (e.g. "Vitrine Studio") and choose the access App Manager. Click Generate.
stores.help.apple.4: Download the key (AuthKey_<Key ID>.p8). Apple lets you download it only once – keep the file safe.
stores.help.apple.5: Note the Issuer ID (shown above the key list) and the Key ID (in the key's row).
stores.help.apple.6: Here: "Add App Store Connect key…", choose the .p8 file and enter the Issuer ID. The Key ID is read from the file name.
stores.help.apple.note: Lost or leaked key: revoke it on the same page and create a new one. Individual API keys (without Issuer ID) are not supported yet – use a team key.
stores.help.google.title: How do I get a Google Play service account?
stores.help.google.1: In the Google Cloud console, create a project or choose an existing one.
stores.help.google.2: Enable the "Google Play Android Developer API" for this project (APIs & Services → Library).
stores.help.google.3: IAM & Admin → Service accounts → Create service account (name e.g. "vitrine-upload").
stores.help.google.4: Open the service account → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON. The JSON file is downloaded – keep it safe.
stores.help.google.5: In Play Console: Users and permissions → Invite new users → enter the service account's e-mail address (…@….iam.gserviceaccount.com).
stores.help.google.6: Under App permissions add your app(s) and allow "View app information (read-only)" and "Manage store presence" (store listing texts and images). Send the invitation.
stores.help.google.7: New permissions can take up to 24 hours to become active.
stores.help.google.8: Here: "Add Google service account…" and choose the JSON file.
stores.help.google.note: "Test" only proves that Google accepts the key; whether the service account may edit an app shows "Check" next to the package name in the project settings.
stores.apple.app.hint: The apps this key can see; choosing one fills in the Apple ID and the bundle ID. You can also type them below.
